hs-on-js-cpu: Hardening Soil is a WASM-only constitutive model. Select the WASM CPU backend (default) or switch to a plugin with a JS reference implementation.
no-load: No active surface load with a positive magnitude is available. Draw a load interval and enable it before running deformation.
no-regions: The deformation screen needs a valid Bishop section model first.
safety-linear-elastic: C-phi reduction safety analysis requires Mohr-Coulomb plastic or Hardening Soil.
